name: Quick Feet
steps: Stand in an athletic half-squat stance with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent, chest lifted, and elbows bent at your sides.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and brace your core tightly.
Lift each foot just off the floor in quick succession, alternating continuously.
Continue at a rhythm you can sustain, then slow to a march.
tips: Stay light on the balls of your feet instead of stomping heavily on your heels.
Keep your hips steady and low rather than bobbing straight up and down.
